source.stem:
A student wishes to find the volume of a small, irregularly-shaped stone.
A ruler and a measuring cylinder containing some water are available.
Which apparatus is needed?

options.text: neither the ruler nor the measuring cylinder
the ruler and the measuring cylinder

intelligence.enrichment: The time period of a pendulum is the time taken to complete one oscillation; if 10 complete oscillations take T seconds, the time period is T/10 seconds. Dividing the total measured time by the number of complete oscillations gives the time for one oscillation. The learner correctly applies this rule: The time period of a pendulum is the time taken to complete one oscillation; if 10 complete oscillations take T seconds, the time period is T/10 seconds. The measured time for 10 oscillations is already the time period, so no division is needed.
